name: Wealthfront homepage — APY-led fintech landing page by wealthfront.com
description: A deep-indigo hero built around one oversized APY numeral, softened by an italic-serif counterphrase and a tilted phone mockup with a debit card layered behind it. Below, the page alternates dark and light full-bleed bands — proof stats, mirrored product cards with checklists, photo-based client stories, a dark Forbes pull-quote plus stat row, a light FAQ accordion — so the rhythm is set by background inversion rather than layout changes. Type scale is steep (display numeral ~120px down to 12px disclosures), depth comes from gradients and layered mockups rather than shadows, and the footer swells with regulatory fine print that reads as deliberate fintech credibility.
